item.title: Repeated fly-tipping and offensive smell outside 84 Peckham High Street, 26th August
item.description:
A large quantity of household waste, black refuse bags, cardboard boxes and loose rubbish has again been dumped on the public pavement outside the closed premises at 84 Peckham High Street, immediately next to Acuherbal Clinic at 86 Peckham High Street. This is a long-standing and recurring fly-tipping hotspot. In warm weather it causes a strong offensive smell and is likely to attract rats, flies and other vermin. The waste obstructs a significant part of the pavement and affects patients, including elderly people and those with mobility difficulties. Please arrange urgent removal and refer this recurring location to the Environmental Enforcement Team. We are not only requesting another one-off collection: please investigate the source of the repeated dumping and consider monitoring, warning signage or other preventive measures.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 82-84, Peckham High Street, Peckham, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
